scope: Bounded offline E2E/seeding isolation safety only
changes: Removed every unsafe legacy E2E/seeder execution helper, account-id range deletion, fixed account password, SQL printing, and native/TCP fallback path from the owned scripts.
Preserved Python main() exit-2 emergency guards and unconditional apply_sql refusal; shell E2E and world lifecycle entrypoints now also fail closed without launching Docker or another interpreter.

Added pure cleanup planning with exact manifest-owned account/character identifiers and names, strict run-specific account namespace, explicit test-world/project/volume identity, exact observed rows, offline evidence, duplicate/collision refusal, and extra-character refusal.

Added inert routing plans pinned to one observed immutable database container ID, an exact named volume mount, no published DB ports, a world-specific network, and explicit database identity; unavailable containers cannot trigger fallback.

Added inert reset plans naming only the exact owned stopped database container and ro-bots-world-test volume. No compose down -v, force, prune, broad volume removal, debug/prod deletion, server startup, or execution is included.

Compose now requires explicit root/user secret files and a world-owned database username; it has no reusable password defaults or DB port publication. Its explicit internal network name matches the offline route contract.
Removed inaccurate live isolation/E2E claims from comments in the owned files.

limits_and_blockers: The new APIs return inert plans only. Caller-supplied observations and JSON are explicitly not live ownership proof or authority to execute.
No trusted Docker/DB observer exists yet to acquire fresh ownership, network, mount, volume-user, database-world marker, active-account, and offline observations under an exclusive world lock.

No mutation executor exists yet: fresh per-step reinspection, transactional row locks, complete account/character ownership revalidation, affected-row checks, error/rollback handling, and exact post-write readback remain mandatory before enabling execution.

Cleanup plan tests verify exact scope and exclusion of unrelated IDs, not real database deletion or persistence. Related character-state tables and full seeding/insertion/bootstrap behavior remain unimplemented.

The deterministic legacy seeder was removed, not promoted to a verified replacement. Fresh credential provisioning, private secret transport, world marker bootstrap, and manifests for an actual isolated world remain future executor work.
world.sh status is also blocked; no read-only live observer has been added. FORCE, KEEP, WORLD_KIND, ALLOW_ISOLATED, or a CLI config path cannot bypass the guards.

Compose syntax and configuration assertions are not a Docker Compose runtime/render gate, deployed network/volume proof, container-rAthena credential/routing acceptance, or real volume reset verification.

Full gameplay E2E remains invalid/unimplemented independently of this safety slice. Synthetic heartbeat/movement/party evidence and the former unsafe gameplay runner were removed rather than repaired here.
Only owned scoped tests and gates were run. Repository-wide checks, dependency audit, documentation updates, independent review, commits, and live acceptance remain with the parent.
